host_memory.measurement: minimum of two retained phase-one point snapshots: candidate-ready and after the 4.221-second preflight CLI had ended; not a continuous watermark

phase_two_after_probes.measurement: single retained point snapshot after all 16 phase-two requests

phase_two_minimum_candidate_mem_availabl: lowest retained candidate-phase point sample across ready, post-probe, and pre-unload observations

host_oom_counter.boundary: host cumulative counter; unchanged across the two retained snapshots

limitations: GPU and host point snapshots do not prove a continuous peak or process-memory watermark; cgroup peak_bytes is the managed lifecycle high-water mark.
Configured eight-lane concurrency is not measured simultaneous capacity.
Resource observations do not establish throughput or efficiency.
Phase-one and phase-two cgroup peaks belong to separate managed candidate incarnations and are not a performance comparison.
